headline: Concord alone yet to concede as Salem fall
dek: Concord have played twice and let nothing past, the only programme in the conference without a goal against. Salem's unbeaten start ended at home to Millersville, and four sides now remain yet to lose.
displaced_by: Salem lost at home to Millersville; five unbeaten sides became four, so the standing count was no longer true

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Salem share the top of the scoring with two other programmes, but their six goals have come from six different scorers; no programme has spread its scoring wider.

wire.line: Salem's unbeaten start is over; Concord are the last programme without a goal against.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match has passed its date without a published result, and no final is missing its score; the record is complete to the day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: The table still rests on a single match, Salem's win at West Virginia Wesleyan; four matches between members follow on the afternoon of the collect.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Salem conceded more goals to Millersville than they had in their first two matches together.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anthony Fusay has kept clean sheets in two of Point Park's three matches, and the three goals he has conceded all came in the other one.

findings.label: signal
findings.text: Leyton Collier's twelve shots have produced two goals for West Liberty; no other player on the leaders list has taken more than six.

last_match.line: Salem's first defeat of the season, and the first match in which they failed to score.

next_match.line: Concord have yet to concede; Charleston have scored in every match they have played.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
